tasks.title: Generic allowlist redaction module (handlers/redaction.py)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Module 1. Creates navigator_auth/handlers/redaction.py plus tests/unit/handlers/test_model_redaction.py — disjoint from TASK-119 (decorators.py) and TASK-120 (default_policies YAML). Shares only tests/unit/handlers/__init__.py with TASK-120/121, which all three create as an identical empty file (idempotent, documented in each task).

tasks.title: Public fail-closed ABAC evaluation API — policy_allows()
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Module 2. Additive change to navigator_auth/decorators.py plus a new tests/test_policy_allows.py. Touches no file any other task touches; tests go at tests/ root beside test_check_access.py (the house location for decorator tests), so it does not even share the tests/unit/handlers package.

tasks.title: Default ABAC policy pack — auth_model_admin_access.yaml
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Module 7. One new YAML file in navigator_auth/abac/default_policies/ plus tests/unit/handlers/test_auth_model_policy_pack.py. No Python under navigator_auth/. Nothing in the codebase reads default_policies/, and the guards deny when a policy is absent, so no task depends on this one. Shares only the idempotent tests/unit/handlers/__init__.py.

tasks.title: Parameterize the _set_address social_networks lookup (SQL injection sink)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec G9. No code dependency on any other task — it should land FIRST to close a live injection sink. Marked parallel:false only because it edits navigator_auth/handlers/userattrs.py, which TASK-123/124/125/126 also edit; a separate worktree would collide on that file. Its test file (test_user_account_set_address.py) is its own.

tasks.title: OwnerOrSuperuserGuard mixin (handlers/guards.py)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Module 3 — the centre of the feature. Imports redaction.safe_fields (TASK-118) and decorators.policy_allows (TASK-119), so it cannot start before both. Every handler task depends on it, so it is the serialization point of the whole graph.

tasks.title: UserIdentityHandler — guard configuration and hardened read path
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Module 4, part 1 of 3 (Module 4 is split because one task would exceed the per-file blueprint size cap and mixes three unrelated concerns). Edits navigator_auth/handlers/userattrs.py, shared with TASK-121/124/125/126 — strictly sequential.

tasks.title: UserIdentityHandler — hardened write and delete path
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Module 4, part 2 of 3. Depends on TASK-123 for the guard configuration, _require_owner_column and readonly_columns declaration; same file and same class.

tasks.title: UserIdentityHandler — redaction, :meta and the safe _filter
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Module 4, part 3 of 3 — the response layer (allowlist projection in the masked() shape, :meta/:sample, head() X-Columns, _filtering -> safe_filter). Same file and class as TASK-123/124; appends test classes to their test module.

tasks.title: Harden UserAccountHandler with the same guard
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Module 5. Same file as TASK-121/123/124/125 (userattrs.py) and deliberately follows the full identity wiring, which it copies with a different column set — spec Module 5 is 'same pattern as Module 4'. Depends on TASK-121 so social_network/_set_address are already parameterized when this task re-reads the file.

tasks.title: Lock down PartnerKeyHandler — superuser-only, return-once token
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Module 6. Edits navigator_auth/handlers/partners.py — a DIFFERENT file from the two userattrs.py surfaces, so it could in principle run in a worktree concurrently with TASK-123..126 once TASK-122 lands. Kept parallel:false because the spec's Worktree Strategy chooses per-spec isolation (Modules 4-6 converge on one guard contract and one behaviour table) and because it appends to the shared tests/unit/handlers package.

tasks.title: Cross-surface integration tests and documentation
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec Modules 8 (integration tests) and 9 (documentation), bundled because both are cross-surface and both require all three handlers to be hardened. Touches only tests/integration/ and documentation/ — no file under navigator_auth/ — so it cannot conflict with anything, but it is last in the graph by dependency.
